about_the_game:
The most anticipated game of the century is finally here!

Pih 2 is a one-hit-kill comedy FPS.

ONE HIT KILLS YOU. ONE HIT KILLS THE PIHS.

Learn every enemy, retry instantly, and turn each humiliating death into revenge.

THE GOAL: collect all the items in each level while the pihs try to end your life.

There's some angry hawgs coming for you. Ever heard of a 🐊 Pihgator? 🦈 Shark-Hawg? 🦝 Hogoon? What about a 🦅 Birdhawg?

There's some weird boats and hot air balloons you might need to use in some levels. Are they easy to drive? No. Will you crash them into things? Constantly.

The first "Pih" game gave people nightmares where all they hear is "YOU GOT HAMMED". Now it's time for Pih 2 to make you dream about being "BACONATED".

Are you ready ?
